verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions monthly account statements or 1099-INT tax documents, whether generated automatically or retrieved through the API. Transaction ledger objects for reconciliation and the embeddable disclosure component are adjacent features and do not deliver statement or tax-form generation. Statements and tax forms are a fair question for a banking product, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an ops user, the paper obligations are automated — monthly statements generated per account, and tax documents (1099-INT) produced and retrievable through the API
